title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Description Role overview: As a Dev Ops Engineer at Scripbox, you will be embedded across teams, supporting them code deployments on the cloud, with speed and reliability. You will play a key role in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that necessary tools, technologies, and automation are effectively employed. Your work will enable our teams to operate at speed and autonomously, deploying new features and services into production efficiently while maintaining high standards of security and quality. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Serve Product and Technology Teams: Work across teams to provide Dev Ops support, enabling them to handle code integrations/merge requests, testing, and deployments independently. • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for multiple parallel development streams, using tools like Jenkins, Git Lab CI/CD, or AWS Code Pipeline. • Container management and provisioning: support senior dev ops in managing a K8’s-based infrastructure with appropriate monitoring • Cloud Infrastructure Management: Utilize AWS cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools (Terraform, Cloud Formation) to build, deploy, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure. • Automation: Implement automated testing, monitoring, logging, and security checks (Dev Sec Ops) within the CI/CD pipelines to ensure stability and security of deployments. • Release Management: Collaborate with teams to plan and execute release strategies (A-B testing and canary deployments) for safe and smooth production rollouts. • Security: Embed security practices (e.g., IAM, VPC security) into cloud operations and CI/CD processes, ensuring compliance with best practices and industry standards. • Incident Response: Set up monitoring and alerting systems (e.g., Cloud Watch, Prometheus, Grafana) for proactive incident detection, response, and troubleshooting. • Collaboration: Work closely with other internal teams to understand platform architecture, integration points, and deployment requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Experience: 4+ years in a Dev Ops with a strong focus on cloud platforms, particularly AWS. • CI/CD Expertise: Proven experience in designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Git Lab CI/CD, AWS Code Pipeline, and Circle CI. • Cloud Proficiency: Deep knowledge of AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and best practices, including VPC, security groups, and IAM roles. • Monitoring tools: Working knowledge Open Source monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grey Log and Sentry • Container Orchestration: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for managing containerized applications. • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation of operational tasks. • Security Focus: Understanding of cloud security and Dev Sec Ops practices, including security testing within CI/CD pipelines. • Collaboration: Strong communication skills to work effectively with scrum teams and cross-functional stakeholders. • Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset to identify bottlenecks, troubleshoot issues, and optimize processes for better outcomes. title: Project Manager
description:
Job Description About the

ROLE:
We are looking for a structured, detail-oriented, and collaborative Project Manager to join our M&A team , with a focus on post-acquisition integration and transition . This individual will play a critical role in ensuring the smooth and timely integration of acquired businesses into our organization—across people, processes, technology, and culture. The ideal candidate brings strong project management capabilities, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to bring structure and momentum to complex, cross-functional efforts. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
End-to-End Integration Management Own and drive the integration plan for acquired businesses—covering functions like operations, client servicing, technology, legal, finance, HR, and product. Cross-Functional Coordination Work with internal teams and acquired entity stakeholders to define workstreams, assign ownership, and track deliverables. Structured Program Execution Establish and maintain structured project plans with clear milestones, dependencies, timelines, and accountability. Progress Tracking & Reporting Define and track integration metrics and KPIs. Provide regular updates to the M&A team and senior leadership on progress, risks, and mitigations. Risk Identification & Issue Resolution Proactively identify potential roadblocks in integration and facilitate timely resolution with the relevant teams. Cultural & Operational Alignment Help ensure a smooth cultural transition and alignment between teams by facilitating onboarding, orientation sessions, and knowledge transfer. Change Management Support Act as a change agent to help teams adapt to new structures, tools, and workflows post-acquisition. Documentation & Institutionalization Maintain structured documentation of integration checklists, status trackers, learnings, and post-mortems for continuous improvement. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
5–8 years of experience in project management , program management , or PMO roles —preferably in fast-paced, cross-functional environments. Exposure to post-merger integration , business transformation , or consulting will be an advantage. Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills; ability to align diverse teams around a common goal. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel projects and workstreams with attention to detail and structured execution. Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Excel) and reporting dashboards. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and facilitation skills. title: Associate Relationship manager
description:
Job Description About Scripbox: At Scripbox, we are a new-age, client-first wealth management firm committed to growing with our clients and managing over Rs 20,000 Crs of Assets under Advice. Not just managing their wealth, but enabling their aspirations through intelligent advice, deep relationships and helping them achieve their financial well being. As we scale our reach across India, we’re looking for dynamic relationship managers with expertise, empathy & integrity to help our clients grow their wealth and fulfill their life goals with confidence. We operate in an agile empower-team structure that enables speed, ownership, and personalized service at scale. Role Overview : As a Relationship Manager (RM), you will be an integral member of a client relationship team, working directly under a Wealth Manager. This role is designed as a launchpad for future Wealth Managers
- giving you hands-on exposure to client management, financial planning, investment products, and personalized service, all within a structured learning environment. Key Responsibilities Client Engagement ● Build and deepen relationships with an assigned book of clients under the guidance of the Wealth Manager. ● Understand client goals, risk profiles, and investment preferences to deliver personalized advice. ● Regularly review portfolios and recommend rebalancing, upgrades, or new strategies in line with their financial journey. ● Prepare client briefs, review notes for ongoing reviews and meetings. ● Ensure timely communication and updates to clients on key portfolio actions or changes. ● Get leads and references from clients and increase wallet share with them. ● Collaborate with internal teams (investment, operations, compliance) to fulfill client needs. ● Develop familiarity with Scripbox’s advisory tools, risk assessment frameworks, and planning models. Process, Documentation & Compliance ● Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client interactions, tasks, and service history in the CRM. ● Learn and adhere to Scripbox’s protocols on ethical conduct and confidentiality. ● Adhere to the process set internally by Scripbox to comply with SEBI guidelines and regulatory framework. Learning and Growth Pathway ● Actively participate in training sessions, knowledge-sharing discussions, and shadowing large investment opportunities. ● Set and track learning milestones in investment advisory, client engagement, and portfolio management. ● Work towards readiness to graduate into a Wealth Manager role over time. Skills &

QUALIFICATIONS:
● 1 –3 years of experience in financial services, banking, or a client-focused role. ● Mandatory Requirement: The candidate should obtain certification of the NISM – Investment Advisor – Level XA & XB exams within 6 months of joining the company. ● Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a willingness to learn and grow ● High attention to detail, client empathy, and process discipline. ● Analytical and process oriented and have the ability to prioritise deliverables ● Passionate about personal finance and building a long-term career in wealth management. ● Good knowledge of Indian Equity & Debt markets and the products available in Indian financial markets. What Scripbox Offers You ● A structured growth track within a high-performing advisory pod. ● On-the-job mentorship from experienced Wealth Managers. ● Exposure to real-world client engagement, financial planning, and advisory excellence. ● A purpose-driven culture that invests in people as much as portfolios. title: Social Media Manager
description:
Job Description Job Summary Scripbox is looking for a dynamic and strategic Social Media Manager (Organic) with 6+ years of professional experience to lead our organic social media and podcast presence across platforms. This role is focused entirely on organic growth, brand storytelling, and community engagement not paid media or performance marketing. The ideal candidate will have a strong agency background, a deep understanding of finance and fintech audiences, and a proven track record in crafting digital content that builds awareness, trust, and engagement. You will own Scripbox’s organic social and podcast strategy end-to-end from content ideation and storytelling to publishing and analytics. You’ll also lead a small in-house team and collaborate closely with creative and media partners to deliver high-quality, impactful content that amplifies the Scripbox brand. Key Responsibilities ● Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with brand, content, and business goals across Instagram, Linked In, You Tube, Facebook, and X (Twitter). Strengthen Scripbox’s voice through thought leadership, storytelling, and topical engagement. ● Content & Campaign Management: Oversee content planning, production, and publishing including reels, videos, carousels, thought-leadership posts, and short-form storytelling. Lead organic social campaigns end-to-end from ideation to performance reporting. ● Podcast Ownership: Manage and grow Scripbox’s flagship podcast, including planning, guest coordination, production timelines, cross-team collaboration, and amplification across social and digital channels. ● Team Management: Lead and mentor the in-house organic social media team, ensuring creativity, consistency, and timely execution across all deliverables. ● Agency Coordination: Partner with creative, production and post production agencies from briefing to output review to ensure brand alignment, campaign quality, and effective delivery. ● Community Engagement: Build and nurture an active online community by engaging with followers, responding to comments, and facilitating authentic conversations that drive trust and advocacy. ● Performance Analytics: Use native and third-party analytics tools (Meta Insights, Linked In Analytics, You Tube Studio, etc.) to track KPIs, analyse audience behavior, and optimise strategy for reach and engagement. ● Trend & Platform Innovation: Stay ahead of social media and content trends, emerging formats, and platform algorithm updates, identifying opportunities to experiment and grow reach organically. ● Influencer & Collaboration Initiatives: Manage partnerships with finance influencers, creators, and thought leaders to enhance brand visibility and credibility in the fintech ecosystem. Requirements ● 6+ years of experience managing organic social media strategy for brands, with proven success in a digital or creative agency. ● Deep understanding of finance, fintech, and investment audiences. ● Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to inspire creativity and accountability. ● Experience collaborating and managing external agencies and partners effectively. ● Exceptional communication, storytelling, and writing skills with adaptability across formats and platforms. ● Highly organised, proactive, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications ● Prior experience managing brand podcasts or digital content series. ● Experience working with wealth management or finance brands. Benefits ● Opportunity to lead organic social media and podcast initiatives for a top digital wealth management brand. ● Exposure to innovative, digital-first marketing campaigns. ● Collaborative work culture with talented marketing, design, and growth professionals. Continuous learning opportunities in fintech, brand storytelling, and digital marketing. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. KYC & Compliance Manage KYC processes (MF KYC and CKYC) for Individual, Non-Individual, and NRI clients, through both online and offline modes Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with SEBI/regulatory guidelines Track KYC status and resolve deficiencies/rejections in coordination with clients and internal teams
2. Agreement Execution Facilitate online onboarding through platforms such as CAMS, Karvy (KFin), or similar KRA/KYC platforms Coordinate Digital e Sign processes for client agreements Manage offline agreement execution, including physical documentation, verification, and dispatch/collection
3. Account Opening Coordination Coordinate Demat and Trading account opening with the relevant internal/partner teams Facilitate Bank account opening and Net-banking access setup in coordination with the Banking Account Opening team Track and follow up on pending account opening requests to ensure timely closure
4. Backend Activation Ensure timely and accurate account activation in backend/portfolio management systems Validate client data mapping across systems (KYC, Demat, Bank, PMS backend) for consistency Liaise with IT/operations teams to resolve activation issues
5. MIS & Reporting Maintain and update onboarding trackers/MIS regularly Prepare status reports for management on pending, in-progress, and completed onboarding cases Highlight bottlenecks/TAT breaches and support process improvement initiatives
6. Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with Relationship Managers, Compliance, Banking Partners, and KRAs to ensure a seamless onboarding journey Act as a point of contact for onboarding-related queries from clients and internal stakeholders Qualification: Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Finance, or a related field Prior experience specifically in PMS operations is a strong plus Skills: 2–5 years of experience in onboarding/operations, preferably within PMS, Mutual Funds, Broking, or Wealth Management Strong working knowledge of KYC (MF & CKYC) processes for Individual, Non-Individual, and NRI clients Hands-on experience with online onboarding platforms (CAMS, Karvy/KFin, or similar) and Digital e Sign process Familiarity with Demat, Trading, and Bank account opening processes, including Net-banking activation Experience with backend account activation systems within PMS/broking/wealth operations Proficiency in MIS and reporting tools (advanced Excel, etc) Strong attention to detail and ability to manage documentation-heavy processes accurately Good communication and coordination skills to work across multiple internal and external teams Ability to manage TATs and work under regulatory/compliance timelines Knowledge of Wealth Spectrum Platform will be preferred Certifications: NISM certification(s) related to KYC/AML or Depository Operations (preferred, not mandatory) What We Offer : Competitive salary & benefits that recognise your skills and contributions. Not just managing their wealth, but enabling their aspirations through intelligent advice, deep relationships and helping them achieve their financial well being. As we scale our reach across India, we’re looking for dynamic relationship managers with expertise, empathy & integrity to help our clients grow their wealth and fulfill their life goals with confidence. We operate in an agile empower-team structure that enables speed,ownership, and personalized service at scale. - giving you hands-on exposure to client management, financial planning, investment products, andpersonalized service, all within a structured learning environment. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Client Engagement ● Build and deepen relationships with new clients and onboard them onto the wealth management book. ● Understand client goals, risk profiles, and investment preferences to deliver personalized advice. ● Regularly review portfolios and recommend rebalancing, upgrades, or new strategies in line with their financial journey. ● Prepare client briefs, review notes for ongoing reviews and meetings. ● Ensure timely communication and updates to clients on key portfolio actions or changes. ● Get leads and references from clients and increase wallet share with them. ● Collaborate with internal teams (investment, operations, compliance) to fulfill client needs. ● Develop familiarity with Scripbox’s advisory tools, risk assessment frameworks, and planning models. Process, Documentation & Compliance ● Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client interactions, tasks, and service history in the CRM. ● Learn and adhere to Scripbox’s protocols on ethical conduct and confidentiality. ● Adhere to the process set internally by Scripbox to comply with SEBI guidelines and regulatory framework. Learning and Growth Pathway ● Actively participate in training sessions, knowledge-sharing discussions, and shadowing large investment opportunities. ● Set and track learning milestones in investment advisory, client engagement, and portfolio management. ● Work towards readiness to graduate into a Wealth Manager role over time. Certifications: NISM CFA Level 1 & 2 What We Offer : Competitive salary & benefits that recognise your skills and contributions. Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth and upskilling. Clear career progression opportunities with exposure to challenging and impactful work. A collaborative, inclusive, and flexible work environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
